## Workload

Grader Priya Anand completed 797 reads during the review period. The work required 366 hours, giving an average of 2.2 reads per hour. This records the workload completed by the grader and provides the basis for review of reading activity.

The workload was documented for the review by Priya Anand, who is also identified as the reviewer. The information indicates the volume of reads completed and the time recorded for that work.

## Quality

A total of 62 reads were checked as part of the quality review. Agreement was 79.0 per cent. The review therefore records both the number of reads checked and the resulting agreement level.

Priya Anand completed the grading and carried out the review. The grader and reviewer agreed to keep the current session pattern.
